axes.comment: Two orthogonal axes (Phase-2 item 7; pattern: kelly-create/LLM-WIKI-skills, no license - idea only, re-implemented). Status is LIFECYCLE (where a page is in its life); confidence is EVIDENCE STRENGTH (how well its claims are backed). The vocabularies are disjoint on purpose: a value from one axis written on the other is a validation warning. confidence 'high' is a human-only ceiling - reserved for claims the Owner personally verified; no agent and no source count can award it.

comment: Lifecycle profile for the LLM Wiki (harvest item 7, pattern: atomicstrata/llm-wiki-compiler, MIT; versioned fields + grandfathering: Phase-2 item 5, pattern: pyrite-wiki/pyrite, MIT). warn-legacy is deliberate: violations are recorded (gateway proposal meta, validator warnings) and never refuse a write. Flipping mode to enforce is an Owner decision (Phase 2 gate) and has NOT been taken. Schema v2 adds the field 'status' (since_version 2): pages declaring _schema_version >= 2 must carry it (error); older pages are grandfathered (warning only).
